description: This file defines a React page component for managing team roles and permissions within a web application. It includes data fetching, permission checks, and rendering of role-related UI components.

methods.name: getCachedTeamRoles
methods.description: Caches and retrieves roles for a specific team.

methods.name: getCachedTeamFeature
methods.description: Caches and checks if a team has a specific feature enabled.

methods.name: getCachedResourcePermissions
methods.description: Caches and retrieves resource permissions for a user in a team.

methods.name: getCachedTeamPrivacy
methods.description: Caches and retrieves privacy status of a team.

methods.name: getCachedTeam
methods.description: Caches and retrieves team details including members.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Generates page metadata based on team ID.

methods.name: Page
methods.description: Main React component for the team roles and permissions page, handling data fetching, permission checks, and rendering.
